status: Planning only; blocked on current dune performance acceptance
intent: Make wetland vegetation fit real shallow-water and tidal habitats without increasing the global candidate grid or per-frame work.
findings: LocalMidPlants excludes every point below two metres elevation, including valid tidal wetlands.
MidFlora excludes all ocean water, even for generated salt-tolerant wetland taxa.
LandscapeProvince.Cover can rename open saltmarsh to freshwater marsh.
GroundProfile.Salinity saturates at five ppt; current nominally salt-tolerant plant limits are below that saturated index. Check actual habitats before choosing a correction.
The existing 48x48 candidate grid, three-member reed colonies and 15/10/7-stem meshes provide a bounded initial implementation. IDs reserve only four members per candidate.
first_pass: Capture actual freshwater marsh and tidal wetland baselines at fixed coordinates.
Correct elevation, tidal-water and saltmarsh identity gates while retaining depth, current, salinity, temperature, soil, canopy and slope constraints.
Improve reed establishment selectively in supported wetland habitats; do not create uniform monocultures or increase upland density.
Keep near placement and expected distant cover consistent.
Verify deterministic IDs, rooted shallow-water placement, unchanged physical terrain/water, unchanged upland packets, actual native visuals and moving performance before acceptance.
